description: This file contains a comprehensive set of unit tests for PyTorch tensor indexing features, including basic indexing, advanced indexing, slicing, boolean masks, and error handling, primarily aimed at verifying correctness across different tensor operations and device types.

classes.name: TestIndexing
classes.description: A test suite for verifying PyTorch tensor indexing methods, including slicing, advanced indexing, boolean masks, error cases, and device-specific behaviors.

classes.name: NumpyTests
classes.description: A set of tests adapted from NumPy's testing suite to verify indexing behaviors and error handling in PyTorch tensors, ensuring compatibility with NumPy's expectations.

methods.name: test_index(self, device)
methods.description: Tests various tensor indexing operations such as slicing, ellipsis, long tensor indexing, and empty indices across multiple tensor dimensions.

methods.name: test_advancedindex(self, device, dtype)
methods.description: Tests advanced indexing with integer arrays, tensor strides, and mixed index types, ensuring correct behavior for complex indexing scenarios.

methods.name: test_set_item_to_scalar_tensor
methods.description: Verifies setting tensor elements with scalar tensors and checks gradient propagation.

methods.name: test_single_int
methods.description: Checks indexing with a single integer on a multi-dimensional tensor.

methods.name: test_multiple_int
methods.description: Verifies multiple integer indexing and reshaping.

methods.name: test_none
methods.description: Tests inserting new dimensions using None (or numpy.newaxis) in indexing.

methods.name: test_step
methods.description: Tests slicing with steps, such as v[::1], v[::2], etc.

methods.name: test_step_assignment
methods.description: Verifies assignment on sliced tensors with steps.

methods.name: test_bool_indices(self, device)
methods.description: Tests boolean tensor indexing, including selection and comparison.

methods.name: test_list_indices
methods.description: Tests indexing with list of indices and overlapping windows.

methods.name: test_bool_indices_accumulate(self, device)
methods.description: Tests accumulation operations with boolean masks.

methods.name: test_multiple_bool_indices
methods.description: Verifies tensor indexing with multiple boolean masks.

methods.name: test_multi_dimensional_bool_mask
methods.description: Tests masking in higher-dimensional tensors.

methods.name: test_bool_mask_assignment(self, device)
methods.description: Checks assignment to tensor slices via boolean masks.

methods.name: test_multi_dimensional_bool_mask_assignment
methods.description: Tests assignment to multi-dimensional tensors using boolean masks.

methods.name: test_byte_mask(self, device)
methods.description: Tests byte tensor masks during indexing.

methods.name: test_jit_indexing
methods.description: Verifies that scripted (JIT) functions involving tensor indexing behave correctly.

methods.name: test_int_indices(self, device)
methods.description: Tests various indexings using integer lists and tensors.

methods.name: test_index_put_src_datatype(self, device, dtype)
methods.description: Checks datatype consistency in index_put_ operations with source tensors.

methods.name: test_index_src_datatype(self, device, dtype)
methods.description: Verifies datatype behavior during index and index_put operations.

methods.name: test_int_indices2d(self, device)
methods.description: Tests 2D advanced indexing with integer tensors.

methods.name: test_int_indices_broadcast(self, device)
methods.description: Verifies broadcasting in index selection.

methods.name: test_empty_index(self, device)
methods.description: Tests indexing with empty tensors and their effects.

methods.name: test_empty_ndim_index(self, device)
methods.description: Verifies behavior of multi-dimensional empty indices.

methods.name: test_empty_ndim_index_bool(self, device)
methods.description: Checks errors when using boolean empty tensors for indexing.

methods.name: test_empty_slice(self, device)
methods.description: Tests slicing resulting in zero-sized tensors.

methods.name: test_index_getitem_copy_bools_slices(self, device)
methods.description: Verifies the behavior of boolean and slice indices in getitem and copies.

methods.name: test_index_setitem_bools_slices(self, device)
methods.description: Tests setting tensor slices and boolean masks via indexing.

methods.name: test_index_scalar_with_bool_mask(self, device)
methods.description: Checks scalar tensor indexing with boolean masks.

methods.name: test_setitem_expansion_error
methods.description: Verifies proper error on invalid tensor expansion during setitem.

methods.name: test_getitem_scalars(self, device)
methods.description: Tests behavior of scalar tensors when used as indices.

methods.name: test_setitem_scalars
methods.description: Verifies setting tensor elements with scalar indices and scalar tensors.

methods.name: test_basic_advanced_combined(self, device)
methods.description: Tests combined indexing cases with slices, advanced indices, and copy/assignment behavior.

methods.name: test_int_assignment(self, device)
methods.description: Checks assignment with multiple indices to a tensor.

methods.name: test_byte_tensor_assignment(self, device)
methods.description: Verifies assignment to tensors via byte mask tensors.

methods.name: test_variable_slicing
methods.description: Tests variable tensor slicing using index tensors.

methods.name: test_ellipsis_tensor(self, device)
methods.description: Tests ellipsis tensor in indexing.

methods.name: test_unravel_index_errors
methods.description: Ensures proper handling and errors in torch.unravel_index.

methods.name: test_invalid_index
methods.description: Checks error handling for invalid string indices.

methods.name: test_out_of_bound_index
methods.description: Tests index bounds checking and error messages.

methods.name: test_zero_dim_index
methods.description: Checks behavior of zero-dimensional tensor indexing.

methods.name: test_invalid_device(self, device)
methods.description: Verifies that device mismatch errors are raised during indexed operations on GPU/CUDA/XPU.

methods.name: test_index_limits(self, device)
methods.description: Regression test for index out-of-bounds with min/max integer values.

methods.name: test_index_reduce(self, device, dtype, reduce)
methods.description: Tests reduction operations (`prod`, `amin`, `amax`, `mean`) using index operations with various configurations.

methods.name: test_index_copy(self, device, dtype)
methods.description: Tests various cases of tensor.index_copy_ with different contiguities, dims, and indices.

methods.name: test_index_copy_scalars(self, device, dtype)
methods.description: Tests index_copy_ with scalar tensors as source, target, and index.

methods.name: test_errors_index_copy(self, device)
methods.description: Checks errors for index_copy_ with out-of-range or invalid indices.

methods.name: None test_index_copy_deterministic(self, device: torch.device)
methods.description: Verifies deterministic behavior of index_copy across different dims with controlled seed.

methods.name: None test_index_add_deterministic(self, device: torch.device)
methods.description: Verifies deterministic behavior of index_add with various dims using controlled seed.

methods.name: None test_index_put_non_accumulate_deterministic(self, device)
methods.description: Checks deterministic behavior of index_put with multiple repetitions and no accumulation.

methods.name: test_index_fill(self, device, dtype)
methods.description: Tests index_fill_ on tensors, including zero-dimensional tensors, with different data types.

methods.name: test_index_select(self, device, dtype)
methods.description: Verifies correctness of index_select across various tensor shapes, dims, and index types, including error cases for invalid dims and device mismatches.

methods.name: test_index_no_floats (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Checks that float indices raise IndexError, similar to NumPy, for integer tensor operands.

methods.name: test_none_index (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Tests that `a[None]` adds a new axis as expected.

methods.name: test_empty_tuple_index (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Verifies that empty tuple index creates a view/view-like behavior.

methods.name: test_empty_fancy_index (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Tests that empty list index yields empty tensors and errors with incompatible dtypes.

methods.name: test_ellipsis_index (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Checks behavior of ellipsis indexing, slicing, and assignment on multi-dimensional tensors, including zero-dim arrays.

methods.name: test_single_int_index (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Verifies single integer indexing on 2D tensor and error cases for out-of-bounds indices.

methods.name: test_single_bool_index (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Checks that boolean indexing with True/False returns the tensor or empty, similar to NumPy.

methods.name: test_boolean_shape_mismatch (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Ensures errors are raised when boolean masks do not match tensor shapes.

methods.name: test_boolean_indexing_onedim (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Verifies boolean indexing and assignment on a 2D tensor with boolean arrays.

methods.name: test_boolean_indexing_weirdness (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Tests for advanced boolean indexing cases that might seem unusual or complex.

methods.name: test_boolean_indexing_weirdness_tensors (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Same as above but with tensor-based boolean masks.

methods.name: test_boolean_indexing_alldims (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Testing boolean mask with all dimensions as a scalar true/false array.

methods.name: test_boolean_list_indexing (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Verifies boolean list indexing, similar to NumPy, with various combinations.

methods.name: test_everything_returns_views (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Checks that various slicing operations return views, not copies.

methods.name: test_broaderrors_indexing (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Ensures shape mismatch errors are correctly raised.

methods.name: test_trivial_fancy_out_of_bounds (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Tests out-of-bounds indices with large index values, that should raise IndexError.

methods.name: test_index_is_larger (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Verify shape consistency when broadcasting indices in fancy indexing.

methods.name: test_broadcast_subspace (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Verifies broadcasting of indices and tensors during assignment.

methods.name: test_truncate_leading_1s (from NumPy tests)
methods.description: Checks correctness of tensor operations involving matrix multiplications and diagonal updates, ensuring consistency with expected numpy-like behavior.
